https_proxy.description: Rust stealth HTTPS forward proxy (madeye/https_proxy). Let's Encrypt TLS, nginx camouflage, CONNECT tunneling.
https_proxy.status: binary not available — GitHub releases blocked by SSL, no Rust toolchain to build from source
https_proxy.setup: Download linux-amd64 zip from GitHub releases, extract, run `./https_proxy -c config.toml`

usage: OWL routes traffic through external proxies at tier 1 (highest priority). Configure URLs in `external_proxies` list; OWL will attempt them before harvested free proxies.
